recipe.visualDefinition: A clean, high-contrast promotional graphic featuring a male portrait on the right, set against a white background with a gold geometric diamond pattern. A large, stylized diagonal banner cuts across the top, housing bold, heavy-weight display typography, while secondary information is stacked in the bottom left.
coreVisualRelationships: Diagonal banner creates a dynamic tension against the static portrait.
Gold geometric pattern provides a textured backdrop that unifies the white space.
Heavy black display type contrasts sharply with the light, airy background.
Portrait gaze directed toward the viewer creates a personal connection.
coreInvariants: Diagonal orientation of the primary header banner.
High-key lighting on the subject portrait.

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Male subject in a grey shirt positioned on the right third, cropped from the waist up.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The oversized, black diagonal display text at the top left.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Starts at the top-left diagonal header, follows the slope down to the subject's face, then drops to the bottom-left text block.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Ample white space filled with a subtle gold geometric pattern to prevent visual clutter.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: White background and grey subject clothing.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Black for primary display text and secondary metadata.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Gold for the geometric pattern, banner borders, and specific subtitle text.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High-value, low-saturation background with high-contrast black elements.

letterConstructionRules: Extremely heavy weight for the primary header.
Tight kerning with overlapping or touching characters in the main title.
Sheared or italicized angle to match the diagonal banner orientation.
Squared-off terminals and uniform stroke width.
characterSpecificRedesigns: The 'V' in the main title is elongated to serve as a structural element of the banner.
Lowercase 'the' nested within the larger title structure.
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Weight contrast between heavy display title and medium-weight informational text.
graphicDevices: Diagonal white banner with gold borders
Gold rectangular badge for status labels

preserve: Heavy weight of the main title
Gold/Black color split in bottom text

candidateDirections.reason: Provides the necessary geometric weight and clean terminals.
Matches the geometric aesthetic and sharp corners.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a clean studio portrait of a man in a grey shirt on the right side. The background should be white with a subtle, repeating gold diamond-lattice geometric pattern. Include a thick white diagonal banner with gold edges across the top third.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add extra-bold, black sans-serif display text inside the diagonal banner, tilted to match the angle. Add a three-line block of uppercase sans-serif text in the bottom left corner, alternating between black and gold colors.

verificationChecks: Is the main title text tilted at the same angle as the banner?
Is the gold pattern consistent across the background?
Is the bottom-left text block clearly legible against the pattern?
Does the subject's head remain clear of the main text?

adjustableVariables: Density of the gold background pattern
mustRedesign: Artist name and specific season identifiers
postGenerationChecks: Ensure the diagonal banner does not cut through the subject's eyes.
Check that the gold color appears metallic or high-quality rather than flat yellow.
Verify that the text alignment in the bottom-left is perfectly flush-left.
Confirm the background pattern is subtle enough not to distract from the text.
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine a high-key studio portrait with a 15-degree diagonal banner containing heavy geometric sans-serif type, unified by a gold lattice background pattern.
